name: BrdBuilderAgent
description: Uses exactly the BRD the user points to (path or GitHub link; scanned PDFs read visually by Gemini), otherwise the repo document Gemini confirms describes this agent (only previews are read for the choice), otherwise generates one from the live app (RuntimeDiscoveryAgent's authenticated runtime_profile, or its own crawl) or from code; extracts requirements machine-verified to quote the BRD, with per-criterion verifiability and grounding, and reports every cap as a limitation.

inputs.name: brd_path
inputs.description: Repo-relative path or GitHub blob/raw URL of the BRD

inputs.name: code_digest
inputs.description: Key source files, used when generating from code

inputs.name: live_url
inputs.description: Deployed URL — evidence source for a generated BRD (crawled only when runtime_profile is absent)

inputs.name: runtime_profile
inputs.description: RuntimeDiscoveryAgent output (pages, headings, forms/field labels, buttons, downloads, chat box, api_calls), collected with the project's test account; the live evidence for a generated BRD

outputs.name: brd_path
outputs.description: Repo-relative BRD path when taken from the repo

outputs.name: brd_markdown
outputs.description: Full BRD text (transcribed by Gemini for image-only documents)

outputs.name: requirements
outputs.description: REQ-xx requirements: section, verified source_quote, priority, kind, verifiability, origin, confidence, self_generated, and criteria [{code, statement, oracle_hint, verifiability, grounded, confidence, self_generated}] (max 40 requirements, 8 criteria each)

outputs.name: ungrounded_criteria
outputs.description: Codes of acceptance criteria whose wording could not be traced to the BRD text (kept, lower confidence)

outputs.name: limitations
outputs.description: Human-readable sentences for the report: caps applied (requirements, criteria, BRD length, evidence size, candidates), an unconfirmed BRD choice, or a self-generated BRD
